name: Home Prayer
overview: Home prayer is a vital practice grounded in sincere communication with God, who promises to reveal great and mighty things to those who call upon Him, as Jeremiah 33:3 assures. Jesus emphasizes the importance of praying with genuine faith and humility, warning against performing religious acts for public recognition (Matthew 6:1). Believing prayer is powerful and effective, with the assurance that all things asked in faith will be received, according to Matthew 21:22.
